notes.title: Campaign - Story Mode
notes.content:
Hey All:

I'd like to ask your opinion about a story that our writer has come up with.

So if you have a spare few seconds here is a short intro to the story, please put a comment indicating if :

1. It is interesting and you would like to see in the game how this unfolds 

2. It is boring as f*** and you would like us to work on different idea (some proposals are welcome) 

3. It is not that bad, however some things need to be corrected (some hints would be welcome) 

If you'd like to read the whole story and give your opinion about it, just add me/ping me and I'll send you a pdf for a good read :)
.
Thanks!

Introduction

Long ago, in a universe far away, there once existed a galaxy of Space Vikings...
For one hundred years the house of Starfall had ruled over a small world in a remote section of the quadrant. Life had been good, for a time. Things had remained the same for as long as any elder could remember. Glorious battles. Easy hunting. Mugs filled with mead. Fate seemed set on remaining steadfast and constant for many years to come. And it continued as such until the day young Kronoss, youngest prince of Starfall was born.
On that day, Hemspher the eldest and wisest witch of hold spun King Starfall a tale of grave news. Far away, across the distant stars, a powerful armada lead by a powerful house had begun the gathering of a massive armada. A fleet of a one thousand ships were being constructed. Thousands of powerful warriors and vicious heroes were making ready to lead their fellow men to glory.
The King thought for a long time, until finally he asked: How long do we have to prepare?
"If the gods allow," said the old witch. "We may have twenty years before the grand armada arrives to conquer us all."
The hall burst into laughter. No one had seemed to take the threat seriously. No one except King Starfall himself. Twenty years seemed like such a long time and for so long, the armada felt far away. But for twenty years, the people could stare up at the sky and see that entire stars had vanished from the heavens.
The King trained his sons for those twenty years, including Kronoss. They were trained in sword and shield. They were trained in bow and fist. They were trained in firearms and how to wear the armor of their ancestors and how to fly ships of their own.
Twenty years past and the grand armada arrived. Watched the fleet, the people of Starfall felt so ready, but they were still no match for their awesome might. Introduction

Long ago, in a universe far away, there once existed a galaxy of Space Vikings...

Far away, across the distant stars, a powerful armada lead by a powerful house had begun the gathering of a massive armada. A fleet of a one thousand ships were being constructed. Thousands of powerful warriors and vicious heroes were making ready to lead their fellow men to glory.
The King thought for a long time, until finally he asked: How long do we have to prepare?
"If the gods allow," said the old witch. "We may have twenty years before the grand armada arrives to conquer us all."

notes.title: Update v798693
notes.content:
Changes:

- New map: Military Base

- Rewritten dinosaurs AI and moving mechanics. 
They avoid objects on their way, so not to get stuck. 
They climb or search for another path to get wherever you can get, so to limit camping on rocks, hills or in caves.
They are attracted by noise. 
They can attack from different angles. 

- Changes to survival mode. 
Enemies will get stronger with increasing wave number. 
Big dinosaurs require multiple headshots to put them down.

- Motion blur option in the menu

- Healing is disabled by default

- More languages support (Spanish and German)

Bug Fixes:

- Negative Bullets Fix
- Survival Cap Wave counting fixed 

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Updates Summary
notes.content:
It was a busy week, here is the summary of what was updated and fixed:

- Achievements added
- Leaderboard added
- Trading Cards added 
- Dinosaur Headshots - you can now headshot dinos 
- Campaign mode - automatically goes through all the maps, it gives around 200 missions 
- Tracker option - you can now enable/disable dinosaur location pointer 
- Health regeneration - you can now enable/disable health regeneration 
- Slow Motion/Bullet Trace/Bullet Follow - you can now enable/disable slow motion effects on sniper rifle 
- Bullets and weapons load after one click (removed the tick confirming load as it was misleading) 
- inverted mouse option 
- 6 music themes with disable option 
- dinos will now slow down when got hit
- tweaks to dins behaviour, each dino has now different damage and hp, so in example raptors are fast and can kill you with one bite, but are easy to kill. On the opposite side, Triceratops or Brontosaurus is slower, has lower damage, but is harder to kill. 
- New maps
- Removed killing limits on maps and survival mode 
- sniper and crossbow upgrades moved to armory tab 
- Tab upgrades renamed to MODES and Three gameplay modes available: 

1:1 Hunt - Hunting one specific target, some side actors can exist counted as "extra kill", to complete mission need to kill target, automatically loads next mission 

1:ALL Hunt - All targets activated at once, will not attack until shoot/approached 

1:ALL Survival - now you can activate survival mode from the store 

You can still activate EXPLORER mode, where you can explore the map when the target is eliminated. 


Bug Fixes 
- sniper rifle fixed transparency issue 
- machine gun fixed texture resolution 
- Uzi renamed to MP5 
- remapped keys, mouse cursor fix, ESC key to go back and exit, dinos attack after one hit and other minor fixes) 
- adjusted speed of dins and spawning points in survival mode 
performance improvement on MOB map 
- Village colliders fixed on ROCKIES map 
- minor bugfixes and weapon prices adjustment 
- APO map waves now spawn at least 4 zombies 
- MOB map waves now spawn 5 enemies 
- Cursor locked inside the view while playing on map 
- APO map fixed 
- Minor fixes 

Thanks for playing and Have Fun.
